<!-- pr-reviewer: 9b8dea828520522205519025d67b758c2c2c115c -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

**What looks good**
- Diff against origin/main is exactly #314's six files (mcp/edit.rs, mcp/tools.rs, operation/material.rs, tests/mcp.rs, ui/src/state.rs, docs/decisions/312-mcp-detect-holes.md). main is already contained in the head; #444's stdio hardening is untouched (no changes to mcp/mod.rs; the tools.rs change is one added table row). The mcp.rs merge kept both test blocks.
- `detect_holes` MCP tool runs the app's own rule (`operation::detect_holes`) and commits ONE `EditOperationParams` through `env.history`, so it is a single undo step. Refusals are by name ("not a drilling operation", "no drilled holes found ...").
- The ~55 lines moved from ui/state.rs are the same logic (same list selection, turret radial half, mill skips radial, same refusal texts and order); the UI now calls the app, which improves ui -> app layering.
- No new unwrap/expect/panic; provenance and doc comments present.

**Local results (merged with main, own worktree)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp`: 9 passed, 0 failed (incl. `detect_holes_fills_a_drill_from_its_model_and_undo_empties_it`).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib detect_holes` (CWD crates/ui): 1 passed (`detect_holes_refuses_recognizes_and_undo_empties_again`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run, by request: whole suites, snapshot lanes, the GUI.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Draft status was set by the author; the reviewer flagged it ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
